title: The Unskilled Leader
english: An unskilled pilot is ready for shipwreck, and an ignorant leader is the ruin of disciples. An inexperienced shepherd has dislocated the sheep's ankles, and a leader the disciples' paths. An ignorant shepherd will not be discerned in the mist amid the sheep, nor in a time of trials will an inexperienced teacher say anything profitable. A general of war and a doctor of the passions is the skilled leader; for he will either not let [one] be wounded, or, once wounded, he will heal him quickly.

A disobedient disciple is warped wood and will never be straightened by continual rebuke. A discordant brother is a string of a dissonant lyre, and by fellowship with him the common limb is dissolved. A drone eats the labors of the bees, and a sluggish brother diminishes the company's virtuous practice. A cowardly soldier.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
